question: When does one liberate others?
premises: He gives supreme intuitive knowledge to him.
When endowed by intuition, then one is liberated and may liberate.
inference: Intuition-born knowledge enables liberation and the power to liberate others.
plain_english: He gives supreme intuitive knowledge to him; O fair-hipped one, when one is endowed by intuition, then one is liberated and may liberate others.
